title: Pin the stateless relation re-verification boundary after producer-local hash deletion

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Extend the existing reference relation-digest reuse contract to account for the next canonical consumer boundary. Measure deterministic ForestEdge payload hash counts across compile_reference_project followed by the unchanged Boolean compile_relation_blocks owner. Do not add a new probe, trusted digest input, cache, digest index, receipt family, public API or production incremental path.

measurement_contract.producer_edge_payload_hashes: exactly len(result.forest.edges), preserving GPU-107's one producer-local canonical edge digest per ForestEdge
measurement_contract.consumer_edge_payload_rehashes: exactly the number of same-plane ForestEdges in the returned authoritative Forest
measurement_contract.retained_digest_coverage: the set of consumer-rehashed edge digests equals the union of PlaneSnapshot.relation_sha256s for the reference compiler result
measurement_contract.boundary_duplication: every consumer-rehashed same-plane digest was already produced by compile_reference_project, so each retained same-plane edge payload is canonically hashed once in the producer and once again at the stateless relation projection authority boundary
measurement_contract.correctness_guard: CompiledRelationBlocks.source_forest_sha256 remains equal to FourfoldSnapshot.source_forest_sha256. No hash result is injected into compile_relation_blocks.

prior_materiality_evidence.frozen_case: 8193 retained same-plane Forest edges in the 512x16 one-coordinate delta diagnostic
prior_materiality_evidence.interpretation: GPU-102 established relation membership hashing as the largest individually observed direct edge-admission bucket in that synthetic profile. cProfile values are attribution only, not unprofiled wall-time shares or a speedup prediction. GPU-108 therefore pins whether the same canonical payload is recomputed across the producer/consumer authority boundary before considering any contract extension.

decision.finding: GPU-107 removed duplicate hashing inside the producer, but one deliberate stateless re-verification remains across the authoritative producer/consumer boundary: compile_relation_blocks recomputes each same-plane ForestEdge digest before accepting Fourfold relation membership. The current contract does not carry an authority-safe digest-to-edge association into the consumer, so deleting this rehash now would require either trusting an unverified precomputed digest input or adding a new revision-bound contract. No production shortcut is justified by this packet alone.

unsafe_shortcuts_rejected: skip relation_sha256s membership verification because the Forest object came from compile_reference_project
pass an unversioned digest list into compile_relation_blocks
positional pairing of sorted relation_sha256s with Forest edges
persist a second Forest edge index solely for performance
treat Python object identity as semantic authority

verification.kind: focused deterministic cross-owner hash-count contract plus existing Fourfold/Tensor integration workflow

claim_boundaries: The duplicated canonical hashing is an integrity-verification boundary, not automatically removable waste.
GPU-108 makes no latency or memory superiority claim; deterministic hash counts are the primary new evidence and GPU-102 profile data is attribution context only.
No production incremental Tensor path exists as a result of GPU-108.
No Tensor-vs-Forest, GPU/Tensor-Core, CrewAI or AlphaEvolve superiority claim.
No OwnerApproval, PromotionReceipt, merge, Ready-for-Review or Gate transition.
next_bounded_step: GPU-109 should measure the remaining stateless authority-verification envelope before any schema change: isolate forest.content_sha256 verification from per-edge retained relation membership hashing on the same frozen relation-compile cases. Only if a bounded existing result/receipt contract can eliminate a material verified cost without turning precomputed digests into a second authority should an internal contract extension be proposed; otherwise retain stateless re-verification.
